title: EthioLLM: Multilingual Large Language Models for Ethiopian Languages with Task Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and benchmarking multilingual LLMs for Ethiopian languages across standard NLP tasks such as translation, news classification, and POS tagging. Although religious texts (like the Bible) are used as part of the pre-training data and the paper mentions the religious significance of the languages, it does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, or ethics.
